prompts.name: vantage-tv
prompts.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Generate ONE finished portrait retail advertisement poster, 2:3 aspect ratio. Part of a coordinated four-poster electronics campaign inspired by the supplied Amazon retail cards: solid background, oversized bold tightly spaced sans-serif heading in upper area, smaller readable supporting copy, enormous premium photorealistic product hero in lower half. Clean generous margins, polished studio lighting, no website chrome, no Amazon or Apple branding, no invented offers, no additional text. Render all specified text exactly. Near-black background with white text. Hero: elegant thin-bezel widescreen OLED TV on two slim feet, screen showing vivid cinematic blue and violet mountain scenery. Text: 'Vantage 55" 4K OLED TV' as large heading; '★ 4.6 rating'; 'Stunning 4K OLED picture with smart streaming built in.' No price.
